name: Condottiere
summary: Renaissance mercenary card battle for Italian city-states; first to control 5 regions or 3 adjacent wins.
rules_text: Board has 17 regions. Each round each player is dealt 10 cards plus 1 per region they control. Player with Condottiere token chooses an unconquered, unblessed region as the next battle site and starts. On your turn clockwise you must play one card face-up to your battle line or pass forever for this battle. Total strength is sum of mercenaries modified by special cards. Turns continue until all pass or a Surrender is played. Highest strength conquers the region with a marker and takes Condottiere token, unless most Courtesans gives token to another. Ties conquer nothing and token passes left. Then discard all battle lines. Players with no mercenaries may discard hand. When only one player has cards left, round ends, discards are shuffled and redealt. Win by 5 regions or 3 adjacent with 4-6 players, 6 or 4 adjacent with 2-3 players. Deals and table talk allowed, non-binding.
unmapped: special card powers modifying strength and tokens
victory thresholds scale with player count
rating_reason: Card bidding for regions, bluffing, hidden hands, clear strategy
